title: MIUI 14 on Xiaomi Pad 5 Fastboot Flash with MI Flash Tool
blurb: MIUI 14 for the Xiaomi Pad 5 — the fastboot installation, done properly, from the MIUI 14 package to MI Flash.
video_description:
MIUI 14 for the Xiaomi Pad 5 — the fastboot installation, done properly, from the MIUI 14 package to MI Flash.

Fastboot installs are the honest way to move a Xiaomi device between MIUI versions. No recovery menus, no waiting on an OTA that may never show up for your region. It's also the route where people get casual and brick something, because fastboot does exactly what you tell it to and nothing else. On the Pad 5 the process itself is short when you're set up properly. The setup decides whether it takes ten minutes or an entire evening.

📱 Device  : Xiaomi Pad 5
🧩 ROM     : MIUI 14 (fastboot package)
👤 Credits : Xiaomi MIUI team

🛠️ What You Need
• The MIUI 14 fastboot package for the Pad 5, linked below
• MI Flash tool installed on a Windows PC
• platform tools, so adb and fastboot are actually available
• A decent USB cable, because a cheap one is the classic reason a flash dies halfway
• The tablet charged and your data backed up

🧭 How It Goes
1. Download the MIUI 14 fastboot package and extract it
2. Install MI Flash and make sure it can see the device
3. Boot the Pad 5 into fastboot and connect it to the PC
4. Point MI Flash at the extracted folder and choose your flash option
5. Start the flash and leave it alone until it finishes
6. Let the first boot take its time, because it always does

❓ Quick Answers
• Will this wipe my data? A fastboot install normally wipes, so back up first.
• Can I do it without a PC? No, fastboot needs one.
• Do I need an unlocked bootloader? For official packages you can flash as is, but an unlocked bootloader gives you options if something goes wrong.
• What if the flash fails halfway? Don't panic and don't unplug. Check the cable and port, then run it again.
